domains_and_motifs.name: Oligomerization domain
domains_and_motifs.description: N-terminal coiled-coil dimerization domain; forms parallel alpha-helical dimer; essential for APC homodimerization

sources.notes: Crystal structure at 2.4 Å resolution; PDB structure available

domains_and_motifs.name: Armadillo repeat domain
domains_and_motifs.description: Seven armadillo repeats that fold into compact superhelix with positively charged groove; mediates protein-protein interactions with multiple binding partners including AMER1, SAM68, Asef

sources.notes: 7 armadillo repeats annotated; extended region 326-442 also included in structural studies

domains_and_motifs.name: 15-amino acid repeats
domains_and_motifs.description: Four 15-amino acid repeats that bind beta-catenin with Kd ~0.1-1 μM; binding not regulated by phosphorylation; intrinsically disordered region that retains conformational flexibility upon binding

domains_and_motifs.name: 20-amino acid repeat 1
domains_and_motifs.description: First of seven 20aa repeats that bind beta-catenin; phosphorylation by GSK3B and CK1 increases affinity 300-500 fold

domains_and_motifs.name: 20-amino acid repeat 2
domains_and_motifs.description: Second 20aa repeat; binds beta-catenin and interacts with Axin

sources.notes: Multiple modes of interaction with both beta-catenin and Axin

domains_and_motifs.name: 20-amino acid repeat 3
domains_and_motifs.description: Third 20aa repeat; tightest binding site for beta-catenin with Kd=10 nM when phosphorylated (3.1 μM unphosphorylated); contains priming sites for CK1 phosphorylation (Ser1505 primed by Asp1512/Glu1513)

sources.notes: PDB 1TH1, 1V18; phosphorylated Kd=10±1.3 nM, unphosphorylated Kd=3.1±0.3 μM

domains_and_motifs.name: 20-amino acid repeat 4
domains_and_motifs.description: Fourth 20aa repeat for beta-catenin binding

domains_and_motifs.name: 20-amino acid repeat 5
domains_and_motifs.description: Fifth 20aa repeat for beta-catenin binding

domains_and_motifs.name: 20-amino acid repeat 6
domains_and_motifs.description: Sixth 20aa repeat for beta-catenin binding

domains_and_motifs.name: 20-amino acid repeat 7
domains_and_motifs.description: Seventh 20aa repeat for beta-catenin binding

domains_and_motifs.name: SAMP repeat 1
domains_and_motifs.description: First of three SAMP (Serine-Alanine-Methionine-Proline) motifs interspersed among 20aa repeats; binds Axin RGS domain; each APC binds 1-3 Axin molecules via SAMP repeats

sources.notes: Consensus sequence LxECIxSAMP; 25 amino acid fragment sufficient for Axin binding; PDB 1EMU

domains_and_motifs.name: SAMP repeat 2
domains_and_motifs.description: Second SAMP motif for Axin binding

domains_and_motifs.name: SAMP repeat 3
domains_and_motifs.description: Third SAMP motif for Axin binding; crystal structure available in complex with Axin RGS domain

domains_and_motifs.name: Nuclear localization signal 1
domains_and_motifs.description: First nuclear localization signal; contains four lysine residues (Lys1768-1771) critical for nuclear import via importin-alpha

domains_and_motifs.name: Nuclear localization signal 2
domains_and_motifs.description: Second nuclear localization signal; lysine residues Lys2049-2050 are critical

domains_and_motifs.name: Nuclear export signal 1
domains_and_motifs.description: First leucine-rich nuclear export signal; Crm1-dependent; mediates nuclear-cytoplasmic shuttling

domains_and_motifs.name: Nuclear export signal 2
domains_and_motifs.description: Second leucine-rich nuclear export signal; Crm1-dependent; works together with NES1 for nuclear export

domains_and_motifs.name: Basic microtubule-binding domain
domains_and_motifs.description: C-terminal basic region that binds directly to microtubules and G-rich RNA sequences; promotes microtubule assembly and stabilization; regulated by importin-beta/RanGTP

sources.notes: Dual function: microtubule binding and RNA binding

domains_and_motifs.name: EB1-binding domain
domains_and_motifs.description: C-terminal domain that binds EB1 (end-binding protein 1); associates with microtubule plus ends; APC is an EB-binding and MT plus end-tracking protein

sources.notes: EB1 isolated by binding to C-terminal domain; C-terminus not required for EB1 association with MTs

domains_and_motifs.name: PDZ-binding motif
domains_and_motifs.description: C-terminal type I PDZ-binding motif (S/T-X-V); binds DLG1 PDZ domains with affinities of 18 μM (PDZ1) and 1 μM (PDZ2); mediates basal plasma membrane association and cell polarity

sources.notes: Type I PDZ motif; upstream amino acids modulate binding specificity; Kd(PDZ1)=18 μM, Kd(PDZ2)=1 μM

alphafold_prediction.confidence_summary: Very low overall confidence with global pLDDT of 48.06; likely reflects extensive intrinsically disordered regions throughout the protein, particularly in 15aa and 20aa repeat regions

post_translational_modifications.function: Priming site for CK1 phosphorylation in 20aa repeat 3; primed by Asp1512 and Glu1513; increases beta-catenin binding affinity 300-500 fold

Multiple phosphorylation sites in 20aa repeats by GSK3B and CK1; mutual priming mechanism where GSK3B prefers substrates with phospho-Ser/Thr at n+4 position; dramatically increases beta-catenin binding affinity
K63-polyubiquitination lost upon WNT3A stimulation; regulates APC function in Wnt signaling

function.uniprot_function: Tumor suppressor protein that acts as antagonist of Wnt signaling pathway; promotes rapid degradation of CTNNB1 (beta-catenin) by forming destruction complex with AXIN1/2, CSNK1A1, and GSK3B; regulates CTNNB1 levels through phosphorylation and ubiquitination via BTRC; also involved in cell migration and adhesion, transcriptional activation, apoptosis, chromosome segregation, spindle formation, microtubule dynamics, and cell-cell adhesion
function.catalytic_activity: Non-enzymatic; scaffolds kinases and substrates in destruction complex
function.tissue_specificity: Broadly expressed with high levels in intestinal glandular cells (duodenum, small intestine), moderate expression in brain neuropil, thyroid gland, and testis; low expression in colon endothelial cells; negative in lymphoid tissues; expression reduced in colorectal cancers

biological_process.term: negative regulation of Wnt signaling pathway

pathways.pathway_role_summary: Central tumor suppressor in Wnt signaling pathway; scaffolds beta-catenin destruction complex with Axin, GSK3B, and CK1; promotes phosphorylation-dependent ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation of beta-catenin; when mutated, leads to beta-catenin accumulation and constitutive Wnt signaling driving colorectal cancer; also regulates microtubule dynamics, cell migration, chromosome segregation, and cell polarity through multiple protein interactions

disease_associations.description: Autosomal dominant pre-malignant disease caused by heterozygous truncating mutations in APC; usually progresses to colorectal cancer; characterized by hundreds to thousands of adenomatous polyps in colon and rectum
APC mutations found in >80% of sporadic colorectal cancers; typically truncating mutations leading to loss of beta-catenin binding and regulation; central early event in colorectal tumorigenesis

I1307K polymorphism found in 6-7% of Ashkenazi Jewish population; not itself truncating but makes gene unstable and prone to acquire mutations; increases colorectal adenoma formation and cancer risk; accounts for 3-4% of Ashkenazi Jewish colorectal cancer
Aggressive fibromatosis associated with specific APC mutations; characterized by benign but locally invasive fibrous tumors

metadata.data_quality_notes: Complete domain architecture with precise coordinates for ARM domain and repeat regions; extensive structural data available (5 PDB structures); quantitative binding affinities available for key interactions (CTNNB1, DLG1); some domain coordinates incomplete (SAMP repeats, NES sequences); canonical sequence not retrieved via web interface but length and molecular weight confirmed; isoform details limited; AlphaFold prediction has very low confidence (pLDDT 48.06) due to extensive intrinsic disorder in repeat regions; phosphorylation sites partially characterized
metadata.modeling_relevance_summary: APC is critical scaffolding protein in Wnt signaling pathway; essential for beta-catenin destruction complex assembly and function; quantitative binding data available for key interactions enabling kinetic modeling; phosphorylation-dependent regulation provides switch-like behavior (300-500 fold affinity change); multiple interaction sites enable cooperative binding and condensate formation; truncating mutations in >80% of colorectal cancers make this protein central to understanding oncogenic Wnt activation; also important for microtubule dynamics and cell polarity regulation
